flow-definition.description: winter_survival verification: tests a snapshot ref (REF, usually refs/ci/NAME) on the Windows GPU agent. JUnit + logs + screenshots are archived. No desktop drop. See docs/CI-PLAN.md section 7 and tools/ci_verify.sh.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: REF
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Git ref or sha to test, e.g. refs/ci/NAME (tools/ci_verify.sh creates it)

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: PROFILE
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: quick: skips slow probes and balance; full: everything

hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.name: SHOTS
hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.description: One screenshot per line: name|KEY=VAL KEY2=VAL2|extra game args

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: PROBES
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Optional probe files/globs (space, comma or newline separated); empty = tests/probe/*.lua

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BALANCE_DAYS
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Days for the balance simulation (full profile; only if build.zig has a balance step)
